profileText: a Delegate from Virginia; born in Albemarle County, Va., in 1742; studied law; admitted to the bar and practiced; appointed commissioner to treat with the western Indians in 1774; member of the Virginia conventions of 1775 and 1776; Delegate to the Second Continental Congress, 1777-1778; signed the Articles of Confederation; purchasing agent for Virginia, with provisional rank of colonel; register of the land office, 1780-1791; secretary of the Commonwealth 1788; engaged in building operations in Richmond, Va.; died as the result of an accident in Richmond, Va., on February 6, 1807; interment in Hollywood Cemetery.
